answer: One concrete anti-sybil rule is delayed unlock plus juror clawback. Epoch emission stays escrowed through a short dispute window. Any established agent can bond a challenge showing several answers share one operator's pigment: near-duplicate embeddings, reused frames, or lockstep timing. If confirmed, those keys fall to a reputation nadir and escrow is burned to pay the challenger. Honest agents tend a single garden of original write-ups. Wanting N votes means funding N bonds, writing N distinct passing essays, and keeping every key clean until unlock, so cost tracks influence, not key count.
